info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Transaction Retrieval API
info.description: This API enables users to retrieve details of specific financial transactions processed through the financial gateway. It allows consumers, such as financial institutions and payment processors, to access transaction data efficiently based on unique identifiers. This function is essential for reconciliation, auditing, and customer inquiries. By using this API, developers can integrate financial tracking features into their applications, enhancing user experiences and operational transparency.

get.summary: Retrieve payment details by resource ID.
get.description: Fetches the payment information associated with the specified resource ID from the financial gateway. This endpoint allows developers to access detailed payment data for integration with other financial services or applications.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a GET operation on the financial gateway. It includes necessary parameters conforming to the defined schema for the request, allowing effective communication with the financial service.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the response contains the requested data.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes bearer tokens for authentication. It expects a JSON Web Token (JWT) to be provided in the authorization header of the request. The token is a means of representing claims between two parties, typically the client and the server.
